reimbursement_policies.evidence: The maternity package bundles cesarean delivery into the global obstetric package, but a non-global cesarean delivery may be reimbursed separately when billed with an assistant-surgeon modifier. The policy does not address DRG MCC severity.

Cesarean delivery global obstetric services are bundled into the global maternity package when antepartum, delivery, and postpartum care are provided by the same provider or group under the same TIN. Overlapping maternity claims may be denied or recouped, and assistant surgeon reimbursement is allowed only for cesarean deliveries when billed with the appropriate modifier.

provider_role_restrictions: single provider or group under same TIN
assistant surgeons only for cesarean delivery
exemptions: assistant surgeon cesarean with appropriate modifier

reimbursement_policies.evidence: On-topic for cesarean maternity billing. The policy allows global obstetrical reimbursement when all antepartum, delivery, and postpartum components are furnished by the same provider or same TIN, and cesarean delivery is included in the global package rather than paid separately. Overlapping pregnancy claims may be denied or recouped.

provider_role_restrictions: single provider or same TIN group
exemptions: assistant surgeons only for cesarean deliveries

reimbursement_policies.policy_title: Obstetrical Policy, Professional - Reimbursement Policy - UnitedHealthcare Commercial and Individual Exchange
reimbursement_policies.evidence: This obstetrical policy governs cesarean-related professional billing through global OB codes, delivery-only codes, and delivery-plus-postpartum codes. Routine cesarean delivery components are bundled into the global package, while increased procedural work may be considered only with modifier 22 and supporting documentation. Multiple procedure reductions apply to OB codes with delivery components.

pairing_conditions: when increased procedural work is documented
utilization_limits: single gestation for global OB cesarean codes
provider_role_restrictions: Same Group Physician and/or Other Qualified Health Care Professional
assistant surgeon required for non-global cesarean coding

recommended_action.description:
Recommendation 1: In Commercial maternity services, bundle 59510 with 59400 and 59430 once per pregnancy when billed for the same pregnancy and same TIN in the same claim cycle; allow payment outside this edit only for assistant surgeons on cesarean deliveries. Apply to CA. Exempt: assistant surgeons only for cesarean deliveries. Peer: United Health also includes 59510 and 59400 in its Professional OB package, and Elevance external limits 59510 to once per pregnancy for the same pregnancy and same TIN..

Recommendation 2: Allow 59514 and 59620 only on the same claim line with assistant surgeon modifier 80, 81, 82, or AS, using 59510 or 59618 as the related global maternity codes in the Global Maternity/Obstetric Package. Apply to CA. Peer: Cigna and United Health both identify 59514 and 59620 as cesarean target codes, and Cigna limits separate pay to the same claim line with assistant-surgeon modifiers..

Recommendation 3: For 59510, 59618, 59514, and 59620, allow modifier 22 only when increased procedural work is documented, and allow modifier 25 only for a separate and distinct E/M service on the same claim during the same global OB period. Apply to CA. Peer: United Health requires modifier 22 on 59510/59618/59514/59620 only when increased procedural work is documented and modifier 25 only for a separate and distinct E/M service on the same claim during the global OB period..

Cigna and United Health both identify 59514 and 59620 as cesarean target codes, and Cigna limits separate pay to the same claim line with assistant-surgeon modifiers.

United Health requires modifier 22 on 59510/59618/59514/59620 only when increased procedural work is documented and modifier 25 only for a separate and distinct E/M service on the same claim during the global OB period.
